@Bettina, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **3 November 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest of 2 Nov says "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your belated cutover recap (8 Dec 2025) gives the same official handoff date.

For the tracker, you may also want the full-handover date: your recap says you kept running PHL day to day until 21 Nov, and Kwame fully took over on **22 November 2025**. So: official change 3 Nov, full handover 22 Nov.
